'''RU''' was a unit of measurement for [[Hull/Legends|hull]] rating. The value indicated how much damage the vessel could withstand before breaking up. It was applied to vessels from [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].

If a vessel was equipped with a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]], the hull rating was often accompanied by [[SBD/Legends|SBD]], the deflector shield strength. An Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] hull was rated at 9 RU. The [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] had a hull rating of 448 RU and shield-strength rating of 960 SBD.

==Behind the scenes==
RU was first used in the 1993 [[LucasArts]] starfighter simulator [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]. It was later defined in ''[[The Stele Chronicles]]'', a short booklet included in the package of the LucasArts PC video game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']].

The term was consistently used in subsequent games including ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'', ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'', and ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''.
